title: the MM2 letter E walk - the eagle, elf and executioner hood turns
audit_label: R804 MM2 letter E walk audit
audit_comment: THE MM2 LETTER E WALK - the eagle, the eblis, the electric marine eel, the ELF family head, the grugach, the valley elf, the elfin cat and the executioner hood pp. 62-64 (the user Go call on the landed dracolisk walk). The pin-time walk from the print finds EIGHT entries: the eagle, the eblis and the electric marine eel on p. 62, the ELF family head on p. 63 (a doctrine-only grouping heading - the grugach and the valley elf stat blocks ride beneath it), the grugach and the valley elf on p. 63, the elfin cat on pp. 63-64 and the executioner hood on p. 64. SEVEN defs ride the R791 data_files extension in the MM1 registry schema, registry 615 -> 622. THE PRIOR-OWNED letter-E index entries: the euparkeria (p. 52, landed with the R802 dinosaur walk) and the cooshee, the elven dog (landed with the R798 letters BC walk); the MM1 electric def owns the MM1 electric eel print, so the MM2 print takes the electric_eel key. THE GRIDS: the 7-row EgStats stat grid (armor class, hit dice, bonus, avgHp, attacks, xp, xp/hp, lair, move, magic resistance). THE E-FLIP: the Letter E gap box flips to closed - 10 closed 27 open. THE SETTLED READS (capture primary, the 1eonline transcription and the archive.org djvu the cross-check voices): the grugach treasure "Individuals N, Q" (the capture "N, O" the OCR misread); the grugach "fighter/druids" (the capture "fluids" the misread); the electric eel move "//9"" the print line pinned verbatim (the moveRate reads 9); the electric eel 6-8 hit dice read the low end (the kuei precedent); the executioner hood hit-dice ladder 2+2, 4+4, 6+6 reads the or-form best 6+6; the grugach and valley elf "90% to charm and sleep only" magic resistance reads 90 in the grid; the grugach print carries no xp level prefix; the valley elf xp is average individuals only; the valley elf Greyhawk raids keep the print em-dash as the ASCII hyphen. LOADER SEMANTICS: every Nil lair reads 0. ONE REGTEST PATCH: the R804 live def walk at the R227 anchor (the R782 site-block pattern, no census marker), its registry census a FLOOR 615 -> at least 622.

While it is usual to encounter a single bird or mated pair, there is a slight (5%) chance that an encounter will be in a rookery area where 5-12 of these creatures will nest. Nests are in the tallest trees, on cliffs or in mountains. There will be 1-4 eggs in a nest. There is a 10% chance that some small, shiny item will also be there (a coin, gem, etc.).\n\nDuring attack, eagles typically dive from a great height. Diving movement is double normal speed (if from 100 feet or more) and damage is restricted to 2 claw attacks. However, these attacks are at +2 to hit and cause twice normal damage. Due to their exceptional eyesight, eagles are almost never surprised. Unless exceptionally hungry, eagles will not attack even the smaller demihumans, although a brownie, for instance, would be in considerable danger, for the birds would attack prey of that size without hesitation.\n\nEagles are difficult to train for hunting. Only about 25% can be properly managed. Nevertheless, viable eggs or eaglets will bring 60-100 gp on the open market.",
